note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do (rename *, lower at line 29; rename block lines 148-162; Bookmark #13: Public health center, lines 764-804) lowercases every column and renames P05A02, P05A02A1..A12, P05A02B to ph_p05a02, ph_p05a02a1..ph_p05a02a12, ph_p05a02b (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, positions 129-142) labels each column, 14/14, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed question numbers (P05A02; P05A02A rows 1-12; P05A02B). Step 3b: live items (14, resp 1-10) match the questionnaire's public health-centre block ('centro de salud pública') exactly; this confirms batch_635's note that P05A02 belongs to this table while the public-hospital block P05A03 is guatemala_2024_homes_publicclinic; no instrument mismatch. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.6 (checked against the rendered page image at 200 dpi); all 14/14 dictionary variable labels are character-identical to the questionnaire text as shipped, so no dictionary-vs-questionnaire wording differences in this block. Printed line breaks (P05A02 stem, A12, B) joined with a single space; wide gaps in the justified B stem on the page image ('nada  satisfecho(a)', 'totalmente  satisfecho(a)') are typesetting, and the PDF text layer and the dictionary label both have single spaces, as shipped. Structure: P05A02 (household member attended a public health centre in 2024, yes/no) is an item with its own stem -> section _1, no prompt; the P05A02A lead-in 'El centro de salud pública al cual asistió o asiste:' is shared by A1-A12 -> section_prompt of section _2; P05A02B -> section _3, no prompt. No whole-table instructions. Interviewer lines 'Espere la respuesta.' / 'Lea las opciones.' and the skip instruction 'PASE A PREGUNTA P05A03' not shipped. Options as printed: P05A02 SÍ 1 / NO 2; A1-A12 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 NS (don't know) is kept on A1-A12 (nominal yes/no/don't-know, not ordinal). P05A02B prints bare 1-10 bubbles plus 98 'NO SABE / NO RESPONDE' (dictionary value labels = own number; 98 labelled 'No sabe / no responde'); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Item content note: A8 ('¿Se mantienen muchos pacientes...?') and A9 ('¿Es deficiente...?') are negatively worded, so SÍ is the unfavourable answer there, as in A12. Skip pattern: P05A02=2 (NO, 3,953 households) routes to P05A03; in the source xlsx exactly those 3,953 are blank on A1-A12 and B, and all 2,933 P05A02=1 households are non-blank on all thirteen. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 48/48 valid item x resp cells equal (p05a02 1/2 = 2933/3953; a1 1/2/3 = 2458/454/21; a2 2444/467/22; a3 1718/1139/76; a4 2569/326/38; a5 1940/937/56; a6 1826/1018/89; a7 2063/752/118; a8 2305/556/72; a9 1439/1451/43; a10 2064/836/33; a11 2702/221/10; a12 59/2853/21; b 1..10 = 96/44/59/72/308/181/325/572/344/848) and all 13 NULL cells equal source blanks (+98 for b): a1-a12 3953 each, b 3953+84=4037; p05a02 has 0 NULL in both. Live: 96,404 rows (= 14 x 6,886), 6,886 ids, 96,404 distinct id-item, 51,473 NULL resp (53.4%).
